name: Annual Regular Meeting Schedule Notice
description: Publication in the designated newspaper(s) and posting at the administrative offices of the date, place and time of all regular meetings for the calendar year.
deadline: at least three (3) days prior to the first regular meeting of the calendar year
quote: Notice of regular meetings shall be given by publication and posting of a schedule showing the date, place and time of all regular meetings for the calendar year at least three (3) days prior to the time of the first regular meeting.
